// Single-violation fixture for the path-field taint scan
// (TestPathFindingNamesEscapeFieldRemedy): one changes.TaskRecord.Files element
// opened with os.ReadFile, found by its anchor comment.
package oneviolation

import (
	"os"

	"github.com/Rivil/dross/internal/changes"
)

func readFirst(rec changes.TaskRecord) []byte {
	if len(rec.Files) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	body, _ := os.ReadFile(rec.Files[0]) // anchor: escape
	return body
}
